description: How a market's prices moved: up to 180 timestamped points, oldest first, each with one price per outcome (in outcome order, 0 to 1). Shows how the market's view of an outcome changed over its life, including for closed and settled markets. The history reads a market's most recent 2,000 trades: when it has more, truncated is true and the series starts at starts_at, not at the market's open.

id.description: Market UUID, as list_markets and get_market return it.

name: get_market_price_history
title: Market price history
